4c41d05b35284047.description: About the Role LUMA Energy is seeking a Supervisor Work Management to join their team in Neom, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the planning, scheduling, and documentation of distribution work, ensuring compliance with funding and control requirements, and driving corrective actions to maintain schedule and cost discipline. Key Responsibilities Lead the planning, coordination, scheduling, and documentation of distribution work to deliver complete, construction-ready work packages aligned with execution priorities. Ensure all work management activities, records, and documentation comply with funding requirements, internal policies, and control frameworks, supporting audits, internal reviews, and regulatory readiness. Monitor cost, schedule, and productivity metrics, validating equalized pricing, forecasting accuracy, and performance reporting. Review work plans and schedules for constructability, sequencing, and resource alignment, escalating risks and conflicts as needed. Coordinate with Construction, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, and Quality teams to resolve planning gaps and maintain alignment between planned and executed work. Track work progress against approved plans, identify variances, and drive corrective actions to maintain schedule and cost discipline. Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and performance management, including mid-year and annual performance reviews and development planning. Prepare and deliver performance updates to leadership highlighting workload status, risks, trends, and improvement opportunities. Monitor and guide team compliance with organizational standards and legal requirements to minimize risk and ensure operational integrity. Participate in and ensure team participation in critical restoration tasks and drills following storms and/or emergencies to maintain service continuity and operational safety. Execute and delegate additional responsibilities based on team and business needs to ensure continuity and responsiveness in operational responsiveness. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in work management, planning, and scheduling within a distribution or similar operational environment. The role requires a strong understanding of compliance, financial controls, and performance monitoring. Physical Demands Stationary Position: Frequently Pushing/Pulling/Reaching: Seldom Kneel: Seldom Grab: Seldom Bend: Seldom Lift/Carry over: 0 - 15 pounds Working Conditions Wet or humid: Seldom Working near or on moving mechanical parts: Never Working near or on heavy machinery: Never Working in high places: Never Exposed to fumes or airborne particles: Never Frequency of working in outdoor weather conditions: Occasionally Work with electricity: Never Loud noise conditions: Never Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

4c447d80faa49eaa.description: About the Role Premium Food Company is seeking a Quality Manager (Meat Processing) to oversee food safety, quality control, and regulatory compliance at its meat processing facility. This full-time role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and is critical for ensuring products meet company standards, customer requirements, and legal regulations. The Quality Manager will also drive continuous improvement in food safety culture, product quality, and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance systems, HACCP plans, and food safety programs in compliance with local and international regulations. Monitor raw materials, in-process production, and finished products to ensure they meet defined specifications. Lead internal and external audits, including HACCP, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, BRC, and Halal certifications. Ensure compliance with hygiene, sanitation, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Regulatory and Customer Compliance Ensure all operations comply with government food safety laws and industry standards. Manage product traceability, recall processes, and corrective action plans. Liaise with regulatory bodies, certification agencies, and key customers on quality-related issues. Team Leadership and Development Lead and develop the QA/QC team, providing training on food safety, hygiene, and quality standards. Promote a strong food safety and continuous improvement culture across all departments. Conduct training for production staff on hygiene, sanitation, and product handling. Continuous Improvement and Reporting Analyze quality data and trends to identify risks and opportunities for improvement. Implement root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action plans (CAPA). Prepare and present regular quality performance reports to management. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in quality management within a meat processing environment. The role requires a strong understanding of food safety systems and regulatory compliance.

4c6e9c9b50da9862.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مصادر الوطن للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم وتطوير وتنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية الميكانيكية، مع التركيز على إعداد المخططات والبرامج الفنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية. تحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة للمشاريع الصناعية. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التصميم الميكانيكي وأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. المهارات والكفاءات القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم للمشاريع. القدرة على تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة الوقائية. مهارات تحليلية وحل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة مصادر الوطن للمقاولات في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. ستتاح الفرصة للعمل على مشاريع متنوعة تتطلب تطبيق المعرفة الهندسية الميكانيكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

4cc1dc628e24c468.description: About Midana Exploration Company Midana Exploration Company (MEC) is a resource exploration and development firm and a subsidiary of Hancock Prospecting, Australia’s leading private mining enterprise. Operating in the Middle East's expanding mining sector, MEC focuses on developing the mineral potential of the Arabian-Nubian Shield. The company aims to transition high-potential exploration targets into operational mining assets through a combination of proven exploration strategies, mega-project delivery, technology, and operational excellence, alongside local partnerships in Saudi Arabia. Role Overview: General Accountant The General Accountant is responsible for managing daily accounting operations and ensuring the accuracy and completeness of financial records for Midana Exploration Company and its related entities in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role, based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, involves general ledger accounting, managing payables and receivables, banking, fixed assets, financial closing, and reporting. The General Accountant also supports budgeting, audit processes, and compliance with Saudi and international accounting, Zakat, tax, and regulatory requirements. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and reports to the Finance Manager/Financial Controller, providing essential financial information for decision-making and maintaining robust financial controls. Key Responsibilities Execute daily accounting activities and ensure accurate and timely entry of financial data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 and other platforms. Maintain the General Ledger, including journal entries, trial balance, accruals, provisions, prepayments, reconciliations, and foreign currency adjustments. Complete bank reconciliations, monitor cash balances, employee advances, petty cash, and corporate cards, reporting material differences. Manage sales invoicing, revenue recognition, sales reporting, and ensure ZATCA VAT and e-invoicing compliance. Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities and support the preparation of financial statements and management reports. Maintain accounting records for fixed assets and inventory, monitoring exploration, project, license, capital, and operating costs. Review and reconcile Exploration Joint Venture accounting records, asset registers, and cash calls. Record and reconcile intercompany and related-party transactions, supporting transfer pricing documentation and Group reporting. Prepare VAT, Withholding Tax, Zakat, Corporate Income Tax, and e-invoicing data and returns, supporting ZATCA compliance. Prepare audit schedules, respond to audit queries, and maintain complete, organized financial records. Comply with finance policies, internal controls, and the authority matrix, reporting errors or financial risks. Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, including invoices, reconciliations, collections, and preparing bank payments. Support the Finance Manager/Financial Controller in preparing budgets, forecasts, cash flow reports, and variance analysis. Record and reconcile payroll, employee benefits, GOSI, leave provisions, and end-of-service benefits. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a general accounting role. Proficiency in Microsoft Dynamics 365 and other accounting, banking, or tax platforms. Strong understanding of general ledger accounting, payables, receivables, and financial reporting. Knowledge of Saudi and international accounting standards, Zakat, tax, and regulatory requirements. Ability to prepare audit schedules and support audit processes. Work Environment and Reporting Structure The General Accountant will be primarily based in MEC’s office in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Occasional travel to project sites and other locations within Saudi Arabia may be required. The role reports directly to the Finance Manager/Financial Controller and collaborates with the CFO, the broader Finance team, subsidiary finance teams, department heads, the MEC procurement team, Exploration Joint Venture finance teams, banks, customers, suppliers, auditors, tax advisors, and government authorities including ZATCA.

4ccd33775a0a6afa.description: About the Role Guthmi Group is seeking a dedicated Accountant (Saudi) to join their team in Jeddah or Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is ideal for professionals with 0-1 year of experience who are looking to contribute to financial operations and maintain accurate records within a dynamic environment. Key Responsibilities Accurately record and review all expense invoices and vouchers. Verify expense invoices and vouchers to ensure their validity and consistency with purchase requests and purchase orders. Classify and categorize expenses according to their type, nature, and cost center. Prepare regular periodic reports on expense movements and conduct relevant analyses. Record monthly accrued expenses, reconcile them, and perform account reconciliations for accruals. Record fixed assets in the asset management software and ledger books, and perform reconciliations between asset records and the general ledger. Record advances in the books and reconcile them with ZenHR. Record prepaid expenses and amortize/distribute them over their actual active periods. Required Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 year of experience in accounting or a related financial field. This role is suitable for recent graduates or individuals in the early stages of their accounting career. Work Location and Type This is a full-time position based in the Makkah Region, with primary work locations in Jeddah or Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested applicants are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4c5281585472427e.description: About the Role The Grandeur Co. is seeking a Sales Specialist to join our team in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on identifying, pursuing, and securing new catering and labor service contracts through direct field engagement. The specialist will be responsible for independent lead generation, client relationship building, proposal preparation, and deal closure, while also contributing market insights to strategy development. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily field visits to construction sites, industrial zones, factories, and potential client offices. Source and qualify new leads through site visits, referrals, cold calling, and online platforms. Identify decision-makers and build long-term relationships with project managers, procurement officers, and company owners. Present the company’s catering and labor service offerings professionally. Attend client meetings, conduct presentations, and negotiate terms through to deal closure. Prepare customized proposals, quotations, and contracts aligned with client needs. Monitor project announcements, tenders, and business opportunities across various sectors. Coordinate with operations, finance, and HR teams to align offerings with delivery capability. Maintain and update a lead tracking sheet / CRM with follow-up status and outcomes. Analyze competitor activity and recommend pricing or package adjustments. Attend industry exhibitions, trade shows, and networking events to promote the company. Provide weekly and monthly performance reports to the CEO with market feedback and progress. Support the development of sales strategies and targeted plans for specific sectors or regions. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant sales role, preferably within catering, labor services, or a related B2B service industry. The role requires a highly motivated individual capable of working independently to achieve sales targets. Skills and Attributes Proven ability to generate leads and build client relationships. Strong presentation, negotiation, and closing skills. Proficiency in preparing detailed proposals, quotations, and contracts. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to analyze market trends and competitor activities. Organizational skills for managing a lead pipeline and reporting. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4c972569568c7319.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة محاور للصناعة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة مكة المكرمة، وتحديداً في مدينة جدة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تسويق وبيع المستلزمات والأجهزة الطبية، مع التركيز بشكل خاص على منتجات القسطرة القلبية ومستلزمات غرف العمليات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تسويق وبيع المستلزمات الطبية، بما في ذلك منتجات القسطرة القلبية ومستلزمات غرف العمليات، في جدة والمنطقة الغربية. زيارة المستشفيات الحكومية والخاصة بشكل دوري. بناء وتطوير علاقات قوية مع الأطباء وأقسام المشتريات في المستشفيات. استقطاب عملاء جدد وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء. متابعة الطلبات والعروض السعرية والمناقصات بفعالية. تحقيق مستهدفات المبيعات المحددة. إعداد تقارير دورية وشاملة عن الزيارات والمبيعات وتحليل المنافسين. متابعة تحصيل الدفعات بالتنسيق مع الإدارة المعنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة سابقة في مبيعات المستلزمات والأجهزة الطبية. يفضل أن تكون الخبرة في مجال القسطرة القلبية ومستلزمات غرف العمليات. امتلاك علاقات جيدة مع المستشفيات الحكومية والخاصة. خبرة في متابعة العملاء والمناقصات. القدرة على تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تفاوض قوية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة بالمملكة العربية السعودية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل.

4cb9cd5dbd47e988.description: About the Role Aroma City Group is seeking a Senior Civil Engineer to oversee civil engineering and construction activities for large-scale mixed-use developments. This full-time role involves ensuring that projects adhere to approved designs, technical specifications, quality standards, and established schedules. Key Responsibilities Supervise site execution, coordinate with contractors and subcontractors, and resolve technical and construction-related challenges across structural and civil works. Review engineering drawings, shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical documentation to ensure project requirements are met. Coordinate with architectural, structural, MEP, and infrastructure teams to ensure seamless integration of multidisciplinary construction activities. Monitor construction progress, identify potential delays and technical risks, and recommend corrective actions to maintain project milestones. Conduct site inspections, oversee quality control activities, and coordinate with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and contribute to the successful execution of high-rise buildings, hospitals, commercial, residential, and hospitality developments. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in civil engineering and construction. Demonstrated experience in overseeing large-scale mixed-use developments. Strong understanding of engineering designs, technical specifications, and quality standards. Compensation The salary for this position is competitive, with an earning potential of up to 18,000 SAR. Work Type This is a full-time position. About Aroma City Group Aroma City Group is a company involved in significant development projects, focusing on delivering high-quality construction and engineering solutions.

4c026596ef0aa4db.description: Lead the governance, delivery, and continuous enhancement of the organization's Performance Management and Promotion practices to support a high-performance culture aligned with strategic business objectives. The role provides strategic advisory, quality assurance, and delivery oversight across performance and promotion cycles, enabling consistent, effective, and fair implementation while strengthening stakeholder capability and driving continuous improvement. Strategic Performance & Promotion Management · Anticipate evolving business needs related to performance management and promotion, assess organizational challenges, analyze cycle outcomes, benchmark market trends, and translate insights into strategic recommendations that influence leadership decisions. · Challenge conventional practices and introduce forward-thinking, scalable solutions that transform performance and promotion practices and elevate the overall employee and leadership experience. · Shape strategies that strengthen accountability, meritocracy, and performance excellence, driving a sustainable high-performance culture across the organization. · Evolve performance and promotion frameworks to ensure alignment with business priorities, strengthen decision-making, and maximize organizational effectiveness. Lead Promotion Cycle Governance and Delivery · Lead the end-to-end delivery and governance of the annual promotion cycle, ensuring effective planning, execution, stakeholder alignment, and adherence to established timelines and standards. · Guide and implement promotion activities across submissions, validations, assessments, calibration inputs, governance reviews, and approval workflows. · Provide strategic guidance to HRBPs and business stakeholders on promotion requirements, processes, and decision-making considerations. · Drive stakeholder engagement, communications, and issue resolution to facilitate timely completion of promotion activities. · Monitor promotion progress, risks, exceptions, and compliance requirements, implementing mitigation actions where required. · Lead and guide the development of promotion governance trackers, analyses, reports, and documentation to support transparency and executive decision-making. Lead Performance Management Operations and Engagement · Lead the end-to-end delivery and governance of the Performance Management lifecycle, ensuring all stages are effectively governed, integrated, and executed. · Provide direction, prioritization, and oversight across Performance Management operations, analytics, learning, communications, and engagement activities. · Oversee the design and execution of Performance Management training, engagement, and awareness initiatives to strengthen adoption and stakeholder capability · Coach leaders, managers, and employees on effective performance conversations, feedback delivery, and employee development. · Lead the development and implementation of change management and adoption strategies for new Performance Management initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and readiness activities. · Review and challenge key deliverables, reports, communications, and recommendations to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment before leadership review or wider release. · Identify delivery risks, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities, driving continuous enhancement of Performance Management processes and practices. · Provide leadership, coaching, and day-to-day guidance to team members, fostering capability development, accountability, and high-quality delivery. · Act as the subject matter expert for performance management practices and trends. · Oversee the development and continuous enhancement of digital and self-paced learning solutions that support Performance Management capability building. Leadership and Stakeholder Management · Build trusted relationships with HRBPs, business leaders, and relevant HR functions (Talent Management, Organization Development, Total Rewards, Internal Communications, etc.) to support the effective delivery of Performance Management and Promotion initiatives. · Provide expert guidance on Performance Management and Promotion frameworks, processes, and governance requirements to support consistent and informed decision-making. · Drive cross-functional alignment and issue resolution across Talent Management, Organization Development, HRBPs, Total Rewards, and other stakeholders. · Promote knowledge sharing and the adoption of leading practices to strengthen the effectiveness and impact of Performance Management and Promotions. Qualifications · Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Promotions, Organizational Psychology, or a related field. · Master's degree preferred. · Professional certifications such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, CIPD Level 7, or equivalent are preferred. Experience · 10-12+ years of HR experience. · Minimum 5 years in Performance Management, Talent Management, Promotion, Organizational Development, or related areas. · Proven experience leading enterprise-wide performance management and promotions cycles, frameworks, and initiatives. · Demonstrated experience advising and enabling senior leaders and executive leadership teams on performance-related matters. Technical Competencies · Performance and Promotion Frameworks, Policies & Guidelines · Performance Quality Review & Assessment · Performance Grievance Management · Promotion Assessment & Validation (covering JD-based and skills-based evaluations) · Reporting, Analytics & Insights · HR Systems & Performance Platforms · AI Prompt Generation · Data Analysis & Advanced Excel · Executive Presentation Development · Process Improvement & Continuous Enhancement Behavioral Competencies · Leadership & People Development · Strategic Thinking · Influencing & Stakeholder Management · Decision Making · Analytical Thinking · Communication & Presentation Skills · Coaching & Mentoring · Continuous Improvement Mindset · Innovation & Creativity · Problem Solving & Sound Judgement · Planning & Execution Excellence · Attention to Detail

4c4a6b8856dd4d9f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاستثمار المتطورة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المحاسبية اللازمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. معرفة قوية بالمبادئ المحاسبية وإجراءات التدقيق المالي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية والتحليلات المحاسبية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة ودقة في العمل. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتوثيقها. مهارات تواصل فعالة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات المحاسبية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

4c919d1385107cec.description: About the Role CMA CGM is seeking a Customer Service Officer to join their team in Makkah, with locations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for managing customer inquiries, resolving complaints, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction throughout the shipping process. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Customer Service Officer collaborates with internal teams to ensure timely case resolution, communicate shipment updates, and optimize service delivery. The role focuses on leveraging communication and problem-solving skills to enhance customer experience, monitor key performance indicators, and support continuous process improvement initiatives. Advanced Desk Responsibilities Serve as the single-entry point for all customer care queries. Maintain full case ownership throughout the entire lifecycle, without forwarding to other departments. Respond to customer calls, cases, and chats within defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) timelines. Handle complaints and shipment disruptions professionally and efficiently. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of issues. Communicate operational updates to customers, including vessel delays and rollovers. Follow up on customer Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as FCRR, TAT, and NPS. Conduct regular meetings with customers to drive continuous improvement. Identify and promote value-added services (VAS) like Carrier Haulage or VGM. Standard Desk Responsibilities Manage all cases based on the First In – First Out (FIFO) principle. Promote and guide customers through the digital journey for an efficient experience. Special Desk Responsibilities Handle Direct Delivery and Breakbulk shipments. Execute and follow up on delivery processes. Manage tailored solutions for special cargo and commodities. Regularly meet with customers to review business needs. Act as the setup point for special exceptions, such as fruit or cross-sell shipments. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a customer service role, preferably within the shipping or logistics industry. Demonstrated strong communication and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams. Proficiency in monitoring key performance indicators.

4c5dbea3ce92cf59.description: About the Role Nestlé KSA is seeking a Field Sales Representative to drive sales within the designated areas of Al Khobar, Dammam, and Al Qassim. This full-time position focuses on building strong customer relationships and achieving both short-term and long-term performance objectives, with a key emphasis on delivering overall value of retail (VOR). Key Responsibilities Ensure coverage of Nestlé items and systematically resolve issues related to out-of-stocks, new item speed distribution, share of shelf, price compliance, and promotion selling. Collaborate with customers to ensure product knowledge through in-person and phone communication. Sell incremental volume for displays and secure maximum support for promoted products. Identify opportunities to sell additional products and collaborate with targeted customers to create and execute business reviews that drive volume. Manage financial resources responsibly and ensure timely payment collection from customers. Ensure compliance with pricing guidelines at the retail level, report competitive price changes and promotional support, and resolve competitive pricing issues. Identify and correct voids, ensuring new items are available, and merchandise products to achieve schematic compliance. Rotate products, handle unsellable products, and resolve systemic problems related to out-of-stocks and voids. Develop and maintain proper relations with department/store level personnel within the area to maximize sales results. Communicate market insights from the retail level to management. Required Skills and Qualifications Excellent customer service and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail. Strong communication (oral and written), selling, and analytical skills. Demonstrated proficiency in MS Office (Excel/Word/Outlook) and other POS systems. Ability to analyze financial, inventory, retail conditions, and other data to utilize appropriate selling techniques. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and meet tight deadlines. Willingness and ability to travel. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position covering the Al Qassim Area. The ideal candidate should reside in the Al Khobar and Dammam Area.

4c5a694603806bfd.description: About the Role Savills is seeking a Senior Project Manager / Resident Engineer to lead a site-based consultancy team in Riyadh. This full-time role is focused on a large-scale, complex development programme. The position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in project management and site supervision. Role Overview The Senior Project Manager / Resident Engineer will be accountable for the day-to-day supervision, contract administration, and overall programme and quality oversight of the development. This includes ensuring safe and compliant delivery of works through all phases, from testing and commissioning to final handover. The role also involves significant stakeholder coordination. 4c958ee79e841a9e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث جمعية جنا لتأهيل الفتيات ذوات الإعاقة عن أخصائي خدمة اجتماعية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة الممارسات المتخصصة في الخدمة الاجتماعية وتحديد التحديات والمشكلات الاجتماعية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل التجارب والممارسات المتخصصة في مجال الخدمة الاجتماعية، وتقييم مدى الاستفادة منها. إعداد التوصيات والمقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب والممارسات الحديثة، ومناقشة كيفية تطبيقها. إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل والاستقصاءات الاجتماعية لتحديد الاحتياجات والكشف عن التحديات والمشكلات الاجتماعية، وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة. تحديد مصادر المعلومات والبيانات للحالات الاجتماعية المختلفة، واختيار الطرق والأدوات المناسبة لجمعها وتنظيمها وإدارتها وتحليلها. تقديم المشورة للتعامل مع المشكلات الاجتماعية مثل البطالة، الفقر، الإدمان، الإجرام، وسوء المعاملة. وضع برامج متخصصة لحل المشكلات الاجتماعية بطريقة علمية ومنهجية، والتأكد من فعاليتها. إعداد الأبحاث والتقارير حول الوضع الاجتماعي والحالات الموجودة في الدور والمراكز. اقتراح الخطط التحسينية والإصلاحية والتطويرية ورفعها إلى الرئيس المباشر، وضمان حفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الخدمة الاجتماعية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل الاجتماعية. مهارات ممتازة في جمع البيانات وتحليلها. القدرة على تقديم المشورة وتطوير البرامج العلاجية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الخدمة الاجتماعية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق جمعية جنا لتأهيل الفتيات ذوات الإعاقة في المدينة المنورة، ويسهم في تحقيق أهداف الجمعية في دعم وتأهيل الفتيات ذوات الإعاقة. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: المدينة المنورة. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

4cb36c772f99f555.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إشراقة الؤلؤ الطبية عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف العام على الأنشطة الإدارية وضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية، بما يتماشى مع الأهداف التشغيلية المعتمدة للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير ومراجعة جداول الصلاحيات والإجراءات الإدارية المتبعة، بهدف تحسينها وضمان تقديم الخدمات الإدارية بالجودة والسرعة المطلوبة. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المتنوعة، مثل النقل، الضيافة، النظافة، تنظيم المراسلات، الأرشفة، والتشغيل الإداري للمباني والمرافق. ضمان تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية، ومتابعة إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بكافة القرارات الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا وتنفيذها. الإشراف على إعداد الملخصات والتقارير التي توضح نسب الإنجاز العامة في الشؤون الإدارية، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، مع إحاطتهم بالتحديات والمستجدات واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج الإدارية. مهارات إشرافية قوية لضمان سير العمليات الإدارية بكفاءة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. بيئة العمل ستعمل ضمن فريق شركة إشراقة الؤلؤ الطبية في الرياض، وستكون مسؤولاً عن ضمان توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لدعم العمليات اليومية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

4c4922327e0333d2.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks is seeking a Senior Microsoft Infrastructure & Exchange Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role is responsible for the health, security, and continuity of the organization's core Microsoft platforms, including Exchange Server 2019 (on-premises) in a hybrid configuration with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and associated identity and email-security layers. The position focuses on maintaining reliable corporate messaging, mailbox availability, and identity services within a multi-site business environment. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, administer, and upgrade Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 on-premises, including applying cumulative updates and security patches. Maintain Exchange Hybrid with Microsoft 365, managing configuration, free/busy, cross-premises mail flow, and directory synchronization. Execute mailbox migrations between on-premises and Exchange Online with zero data loss and tested rollback plans. Manage mailbox lifecycle, distribution and shared mailboxes, mail flow, transport rules, connectors, and certificate lifecycle. Design, build, and maintain Database Availability Groups (DAG) for Exchange high availability, including failover testing. Perform advanced Active Directory administration, including domain services, sites, trusts, OU design, delegation, and permissions. Design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize Group Policy Objects (GPO). Administer and maintain DNS and DHCP infrastructure services. Manage AD replication health, security hardening, and disaster recovery readiness. Administer enterprise email security solutions, including anti-spam, anti-phishing, malware protection, and content filtering. Manage sender authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and investigate email-borne threats. Apply networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs) to ensure messaging and identity security and reachability. Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Single Sign-On (SSO), coordinating with Information Security. Develop and maintain PowerShell scripting and automation for provisioning, reporting, and bulk operations. Provide senior-level escalation support for messaging, identity, and email security incidents. Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and as-built diagrams. Ensure messaging and identity business continuity/disaster recovery plans meet requirements, including periodic testing of DAG failover and AD recovery procedures. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent experience with strong certification is acceptable. For a senior role, 8+ years of experience in enterprise Microsoft infrastructure, with 5+ years hands-on with Exchange Server (2016/2019) on-premises and Exchange hybrid with Microsoft 365 in a mid-to-large, multi-site enterprise environment. This includes experience with a full Exchange migration and DAG deployment. A strong mid-senior Saudi national with 6+ years of experience and depth in Active Directory / Entra ID / Microsoft 365, with a commitment to mastering on-premises Exchange, is encouraged to apply and will be supported through a structured certification ramp. Certifications Strongly preferred: MCSE: Messaging or MCSE: Server Infrastructure (or legacy MCITP: Enterprise Messaging). Preferred: Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate (MS-203); Enterprise Administrator Expert (MS-102); Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300); Windows Server Hybrid Administrator (AZ-800/AZ-801). Nice-to-have: Email security vendor certification (Proofpoint / Mimecast / Microsoft Defender for Office 365), a networking certification (CCNA-level), and a security baseline (SC-900 / Security+). Work Arrangement This role is based in Riyadh, with on-site and hybrid working arrangements in line with organizational policy. Standard working hours apply, with flexibility to support business needs. The position involves participation in an on-call rotation for critical messaging, identity, and email security incidents, including outside standard working hours. Major changes are executed within approved maintenance windows, typically outside peak hours, with change-management sign-off. Adherence to information security, data-handling, and privileged-access controls is required. Performance Indicators Maintain high availability of messaging services and prevent outages through timely certificate management and patching. Respond to critical messaging and identity incidents within agreed targets, restore services promptly, and document root causes. Deliver mailbox migration waves on schedule with zero data loss and tested rollbacks. Keep systems patched in line with approved security baselines and remediate critical vulnerabilities within required timeframes. Ensure email security with SPF/DKIM/DMARC at enforcement, measured by reduction in delivered phishing/spam with a controlled false-positive rate. Periodically test business continuity and disaster recovery procedures, documenting successful recovery tests. Maintain current technical runbooks and infrastructure documentation for all owned services.

4c799c3b05c38615.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. فهم عميق لبرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية والصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة. المهارات الشخصية مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. القدرة على متابعة التطورات التقنية وتطبيقها. مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة المشاريع. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

4c986a1d1e38c8e7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن سكرتير تنفيذي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تقديم الدعم الإداري والتنظيمي للمدير أو الرئيس، مما يضمن سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وفعالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم وتنسيق مواعيد المدير/الرئيس وتذكيره بها بشكل مستمر. التعامل مع الاستفسارات الواردة والرد عليها، بالإضافة إلى استلام وتوصيل البريد والمراسلات للمدير/الرئيس. إعداد المذكرات الدورية والمراسلات المتعلقة بعمل الوحدات التنظيمية الداخلية. إجراء المراسلات الاعتيادية مع الجهات الخارجية، والتأكد من توقيعها من المدير/الرئيس، ثم توزيعها. حضور الاجتماعات وتسجيل محاضرها وتحريرها بدقة. حفظ وتصنيف الوثائق والملفات المتعلقة بأعمال المدير/الرئيس بطريقة منظمة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها لضمان سهولة الرجوع إليها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال السكرتارية التنفيذية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تنظيم المهام المتعددة وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة مهنية داعمة في شركة معين للموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

4ca19c1b0bf5fa1f.description: About the Internship AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is offering an internship for a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This 3-month, full-time internship (40 hours per week) is scheduled to begin in summer 2027 and is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs. Role Overview As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern, you will gain hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure supporting Amazon's global data centers. The role involves providing technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers, ensuring mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate with 100% availability. This position requires daily on-site presence, typically Sunday through Thursday day schedules. Full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays; candidates should be prepared for this commitment upon transitioning to a full-time position. Key Responsibilities Maintain mechanical and electrical equipment. Assist with root cause analysis of equipment failures. Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment. Utilize internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows. Interact with third-party vendors and contractors working on site. Equipment Exposure Interns will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers, maintaining better than **** uptime. This includes, but is not limited to: Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear. Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs). Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers. Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs). Building automation systems. Required Skills and Qualifications This internship is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Critical skills for success include prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly to situations. The role involves both independent work and team-based collaboration. About the Team The AWS Infrastructure Services team is responsible for the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure, including data centers and all supporting equipment. Interns will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers, collaborating across AWS to maintain high standards for safety and security while ensuring continuous access to services for customers.

4cfe500f05ca8399.description: About the Role Abyatona Contracting & Development is seeking a Senior Procurement Specialist for Infrastructure & Building Projects. Key Responsibilities Review project documents including RFPs, BOQs, technical specifications, drawings, and PRs to analyze item descriptions, quantities, and requirements. Identify and clarify discrepancies or missing information with the technical department to define a clear procurement scope. Handle procurement for infrastructure materials (*, pipes, pumps, road materials, cables) and building materials (*, steel, concrete, finishes, MEP systems). Identify original manufacturers, authorized distributors, and evaluate suppliers based on technical capabilities, production capacity, delivery reliability, and quality. Prepare and issue RFQs, conduct detailed technical and commercial evaluations, and recommend purchases based on best overall value. Negotiate commercial terms including prices, discounts, delivery schedules, and payment terms, ensuring alignment with company policy. Manage technical approvals for samples, catalogues, and material submittals, ensuring consistency with final quotations and purchase orders. Monitor manufacturing and delivery progress, coordinate with site teams for receipt verification, and resolve any shortages or non-compliant materials. Match purchase orders, goods receipt records, and invoices for payment processing and maintain comprehensive procurement records. Prepare periodic reports on procurement status, financial commitments, savings, and supplier performance. Documented cost savings while maintaining quality and specifications. Timely closure of approvals, outstanding issues, and supplier claims. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in procurement, specifically within infrastructure and building projects. Arabic speaker with good English language Knowledge of food safety and hygiene practices.

4c091dacc34f0a1d.description: Job Summary We are seeking a professional, polished, and guest-focused Call Centre & Reservations Representative to join the team at The Groves in Riyadh. As one of the first points of contact for our guests, you will play an important role in creating a seamless and positive guest experience. You will manage incoming calls and enquiries, assist guests with restaurant reservations, provide information about our dining, entertainment and retail offerings, and ensure every interaction reflects the high standards of The Groves. This is a seasonal position for approximately 6–7 months , ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced, premium hospitality and entertainment environment and has a genuine passion for delivering exceptional guest service. Answer incoming calls promptly, professionally, and with a warm and welcoming approach. Handle restaurant reservations, booking enquiries, amendments, cancellations, and general guest requests accurately. Provide guests with clear and up-to-date information about restaurants, menus, events, entertainment, operating hours, promotions, facilities, and experiences . Assist guests in selecting suitable restaurants or experiences based on their requirements and preferences. Manage high volumes of enquiries during peak periods while maintaining a calm, professional, and friendly manner. Confirm booking details and ensure all guest information is accurately recorded in the relevant reservation or CRM system. Respond to guest questions and concerns, taking ownership of enquiries through to resolution wherever possible. Handle complaints professionally and sensitively, escalating matters to the appropriate department or supervisor when required. Coordinate with restaurants, guest relations, operations, and other departments to ensure guest requests are followed through. Maintain accurate records of guest interactions, bookings, requests, and follow-ups. Proactively communicate any changes to reservations, operating hours, events, or guest arrangements. Ensure all guest interactions are handled in line with service standards and brand experience . Protect guest information and maintain confidentiality at all times. Identify opportunities to enhance the guest experience through personalised service and thoughtful recommendations. Support the wider Guest Experience team during busy periods and major events as required. 2 years experience in a call center, hospitality, or customer service role. Business level proficiency in both Arabic and English (spoken and written). Prior experience in a call centre, hospitality, or customer service role is required. Willing to work shifts on rotation one of them ending at midnight. Naturally warm, professional, and service-oriented. Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure. Familiarity with F&B, hospitality, or entertainment industries is an advantage. Most importantly, we are looking for someone who understands that every call is an opportunity to create a great first impression. You should be guest-obsessed, solutions-focused, and confident representing a premium hospitality destination . This role is not simply about answering calls — it is about connecting guests with the experiences and ensuring their journey begins with exceptional service. About The Group: SIHAMCO is a strategic partner operating proudly under the General Entertainment Authority (GEA), National Events Center (NEC), Riyadh Season and Jeddah Season since 2019. At SIHAMCO, we don’t just lead Saudi Arabia’s hospitality and entertainment evolution—we create it from the ground up. Since 2008, we’ve been designing, constructing, and operating exceptional experiences that blend local authenticity with global standards. Every destination and concept we launch reflects our commitment to cultural storytelling, creative excellence, and operational precision. Crafting a Homegrown Legacy All brands under SIHAMCO are homegrown Saudi concepts, fully developed in-house — from initial vision and brand identity to concept creation, design, execution and operation. We don’t import ideas; we build them — crafting unforgettable experiences from scratch that resonate deeply with both local and international audiences. Our Signature Brands Every brand under our umbrella is proudly reflecting the heart and soul of Saudi culture, while achieving international acclaim. With over 25 original homegrown brands, SIHAMCO not only sets — but consistently surpasses — global standards in Entertainment, Hospitality, F&B, Lifestyle, Wellness, Family & Pet Entertainment Experience. Our signature ventures: The Groves, ZodiaC Cuisine, Little Krazy, LucaLand, LucaPark, The Polar Ice Bar, Milk & Butter Nail Spa, Kooz Karak, Birds of Eden, El Lechazo, Khawaja Yanni, Zama Zulu, Hawanim Groves City, Vida Vera, The Groves Pizzeria and Gem-In-I showcase what it means to innovate locally and shine globally. Our brands are also registered across the GCC and internationally such as the United Kingdom, Egypt, Morocco etc ensuring full legal protection and readiness for global expansion. We Are Only Getting Started! Several exciting new concepts and brands are currently under development, with launches planned in the coming months. From bold new ideas to thoughtfully crafted experiences, SIHAMCO continues to grow its portfolio with originality, creativity and cultural pride. People First Our team is our greatest asset—a dynamic mix of local talent and international expertise, all united by a passion for excellence. We nurture careers, encourage creativity, and build leaders. At SIHAMCO, we believe in rewarding our team with more than just a job — we offer an inspiring work environment and real opportunities for growth. Our benefits include: Competitive salary packages – aligned with market standards and experience Career development & Internal promotions – grow with us across departments and seasons Creative & collaborative work culture – built on passion, innovation, and attention to detail Exposure to high-end hospitality & entertainment concepts – gain experience in premium F&B and entertainment Experience working on premium events within The Groves, Riyadh Season Cultural diversity – join a team of passionate professionals from around the world Join us and be part of a company that’s redefining hospitality in Saudi Arabia and beyond.

سائقي الباصات والمرافقين وتوجيههم بما يلزم. متابعة نظافة وكفاءة تشغيل الباصات. استلام وتسليم المستفيدين من وإلى الباصات وتعبئة قائمة نزول المستفيدين من الباص للقسم. مسؤول عن توزيع العاملات والحاضنات الفيديوهات وإرسالها للأهل أسبوعياً). المشاركة بالأنشطة الجماعية والرحلات الخارجية. متابعة طلبات الطباعة وتصوير الأوراق. المشاركة في أعمال الفريق والتعاون معهم. تجميع تحضير الفصول الورقي نهاية كل أسبوع لدورات المياه). المتابعة على نظافة الفصول ومتابعة ترتيبها. المساعدة فترة الوجبة عند الحاجة. مساعدة الأخصائي الاجتماعي باستكمال ملفات المستفيدين. المشاركة بالأنشطة الجماعية الداخلية والخارجية بالمركز. مراعاة سلامة المستفيدين داخل المركز. الاحتفاظ بأدوات النظافة في المكان المخصص لها بعيداً عن المستفيدين. مسؤوليات أخرى: أي مهام يكلف بها من المدير المباشر. الكفاءات والمهارات: المؤهلات العلمية: المؤهل 4cfc90bf426a08ba.description: About The Role Müller's Solutions is looking for a senior SAP Supply Chain and Procurement consultant to own the Source-to-Pay and inventory management workstream on a S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation for a major trading group in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This is a broad, senior generalist role — you will be the single specialist covering procurement, supplier management, and core inventory processes across 4 legal entities. You will work primarily offshore, joining the client onsite in Riyadh for key Fit-to-Standard workshops, UAT, and go-live. You'll partner closely with the Finance and Integration workstreams, since procurement processes touch both heavily in this engagement. What You'll Own — Fit-to-Standard workshops covering procurement and inventory processes, translating client requirements into standard S/4HANA Cloud configuration. — End-to-end configuration of purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and goods receipt workflows. — Supplier master data setup, purchasing contracts, and supplier evaluation and performance monitoring. — Core inventory and stock management configuration across all 4 legal entities. — The integration design touchpoints between Procurement (MM) and Finance (FI), working closely with the Finance Lead. — Data migration scope for vendor master records and open purchase orders, in coordination with the Data Migration Consultant. — End-user training delivery for procurement and inventory users during the Deploy phase. — 5+ years of SAP MM / Supply Chain consulting experience, with at least one full-cycle implementation as lead consultant. — Hands-on configuration experience in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition procurement processes. — Strong, demonstrable knowledge of the full Source-to-Pay process — from requisition through invoice settlement. — Practical experience with basic warehouse and inventory management configuration. — Comfort working independently across a broad scope, without a large team of specialists to lean on. — Solid understanding of MM-FI integration points: goods receipt, invoice verification, accruals. Preferred — Prior project experience in the KSA market, with familiarity around local procurement and supplier practices. — Exposure to intercompany stock transfer and subcontracting processes. — Working knowledge of Arabic, written or spoken. — Experience in trading, distribution, or bulk commodities client environments.
